sections.A: Patellofemoral pain ghutne ke aage, chapni (patella) ke gird ya peeche dard hai jo ghutne ko mod kar load dene wale kaamon se barhta hai.
sections.B: Ghutne ke aage phaila hua dard jo ek ungli se dikhana mushkil hai, seerhiyan utarne, squat, ghutne tekne aur der tak mude ghutne baithne se.
sections.C: Dard chapni ke gird ya peeche hai ya neeche (tendon), aur load haal mein barha ya nahi.
sections.D: Khade hone ki seedh, pair ki shakal aur muscles dekhein; single-leg squat ya step-down par dard.
sections.E: Purane patella tests (compression, grind, Q-angle) ki accuracy kam hai. Squat ya step-down par dard zyada kaam ka hai.
sections.F: Patellar tendinopathy (chapni ke neeche dard), fat pad aur hip se aata dard isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Langrata naujawan aur hip rotation kam ya dard wali: hip ka masla jo ghutne mein mehsoos hota hai, urgent refer.
sections.H: Red flags aur hip rule out karein. Phir ghutne ke aage dard jo mude ghutne par load se barhe: PFP.
sections.I: Quadriceps, ITB ke ilaqe aur pindli par soft tissue kaam, exercise ko aasaan banane ke liye.
sections.J: Ghutne aur hip ki milkar exercise asal ilaaj hai, saath mein load ki samajh aur dheere dheere wapsi.
sections.L: Hip screen karein, samjhayein ke yeh chapni ka 'khisakna' nahi balke load ka masla hai, phir 6 se 12 hafte exercise.
sections.M: Single-leg squat ya step-down par dard, Kujala score, taaqat aur patient ka goal dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 24 saal ki runner ko running barhane ke baad ghutne ke aage dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, load control aur exercise therapy.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
